title: Page 8
content_zh:
“好啊！我就帮你这个忙。”用施舍似的语气，一把抢过乔若曦手中的保温壶，洪小琦心里暗自窃喜。
“谢谢。”如释重负的乔若曦连连跟她道谢。
第二天乔若曦依然是早上就来了，带着一锅清炖牛肉汤等在医院大门前。她看到洪小琦，连忙迎上前去，很高兴等到她。否则这锅汤还不知道怎么送上去呢！
“洪小姐，你好。”
“你怎么还来？”
“呃……”面对她不耐烦的态度，乔若曦尴尬的不知道该怎么回答。“那个……昨天的鸡汤，他有喝吧？”
“是啊！”洪小琦得意的笑。“天阔哥还称赞我，说不知道我那么体贴呢！我看以后他不会再把我当小女孩，会开始注意到我的好，可能会爱上我喔！”
她本来讲这话是要气气乔若曦，让她呕说自己辛苦付出却被人抢去功劳，可是乔若曦的反应跟她想像的差很多——
她像松了口气似的说：“是吗？他喝了，那就太好了。”
这女人是傻子吗？洪小琦皱眉。
“那今天可以麻烦你再拿这锅汤给他吗？”
乔若曦恭敬的献上手里的汤，仿佛怕她不同意似的还乞求的仰望着她。
既然有人自愿当枪手，她可不会客气占这送上门的便宜。
“好啊！”
看着洪小琦扭头走进医院的背影，乔若曦的眼里充满羡慕。
她多么希望自己是那个能够光明正大走进天阔病房的人，她好想见他，知道他现在好不好。
不过至少他喝了汤应该会快点好……
能够提供这点小小的帮助让乔若曦感到欣慰，她高兴又苦涩的微笑，一边想着明天得炖什么样的补汤才好……
被困在医院的日子让褚天阔烦闷至极。
身上那些伤困扰不了他，让他烦躁的原因是小琦每天都来看他；然而困扰他的不是小琦，而是她每天拿来的那些汤。

他怎么会喝不出来那是谁做的。
就算喝不出来，他也看得出来。那个笨女人一定不知道他的单人病房有绝佳的视野，可以看到医院大门，当然也看得到每天早上十点多就在那里等着小琦的人……
“喂，大熊，我跟你讲话你有没有听到？怎么，你是摔坏脑子了不成？”
一个声音把他的视线从窗口唤回来。
他绷着脸看着徐士凯，看着好友那张英俊得让人妒忌的脸孔。
以前身为朋友不会特别注意，但现在仔细一想，他的条件确实拥有吸引女人注意的本钱——出身世家，高学历，长相俊美；身材结实又不至于太壮硕，最重要的是讲话幽默风趣，又知道怎么讨女孩子欢心。
不得不承认他比自己要好太多，也难怪若曦会喜欢他。
当初就应该发现的，怎么会以为有徐上凯在旁边，她还会看上他呢？
“怎么不讲话？干么这样看我？很吓人耶！大熊，你不会真的脑袋不清楚吧？”徐士凯被瞪得莫名其妙。好友的眼神阴沉锐利，看得他一阵胆颤心惊，仿佛他做了什么对不起他的事一样。
“没什么，谢谢你的关心。”
他终于移开视线，那像巨石般沉甸甸压在肩头的压力也顿时消失了，徐士凯松了口气。“对了，怎么没看到你女朋友？她没来照顾你吗？”
闻言，褚天阔抿紧唇。
又来了，徐士凯暗自叫苦。
他今天是怎么了？怎么好像讲什么话都不对？徐士凯咽了口口水。大熊平常是很沉默寡言没错，可是从来没有用黑道大哥那一面对待他过，可是今天他确实领教了他天生惊人的压迫感。
“你觉得她怎样？”
“谁？噢，你说你女朋友？很好啊！嗯……不是那种第一眼就让人惊艳的大美人，不过跟她在一起应该感觉很舒服，贤慧又温柔，是那种让人想要娶回家的类型。”
他以为赞美他的女朋友会让他心情好些，可是显然不是，因为褚天阔的表情此刚刚更可怕。
“阿丰！”褚天阔扬声把阿丰叫过来。
“老大，什么事？”“让她进来。”
老大没头没脑突然这么说，阿丰一下子还会意不过来，直到褚天阔不耐烦的说：“现在站在医院门口的那个人，你下去把她叫上来！”

“噢、好！”没敢再多问，阿丰连忙出去办老大交代的事了。
到了医院门口，阿丰睁大眼睛，他知道老大说的人是谁了。不过最厉害的是老大，他没有离开过病房，是怎么知道大嫂站在这边的？
“大嫂，老大请你上去见他。”
原本在等洪小琦的乔若曦又惊又喜。“他让我见他？真的？”
“是啊，你快上来吧！是老大自己说的。”
“好、好。”
开心的跟着阿丰走进电梯，乔若曦原本苍白的小脸染上兴奋的嫣红。他终于肯见她了，等会见到他，她得先看看他的伤怎样了，问问他还有没有哪里不舒服，他想吃什么。还有，她得趁这个机会跟他把误会解开……
“老大，人来了。”
阿丰敲开病房的门，乔若曦脸上的微笑在看见病房里的另外一个人时稍稍僵硬了一下，随即又心急的想关心褚天阔的伤。
胡乱跟徐上凯点了点头，她快步走近褚天阔。“你还好吗？现在怎么样？”
“谢谢你的关心。”他的声音冷淡疏远，就像是陌生人一样的客气。
她强压下受伤的感觉，鼓励自己他愿意见她，表示一切就有转机了。
“我给你带了一些吃的，吃些营养的东西身体也好得比较快。”
“不用麻烦了。”依然是冷淡的拒绝，褚天阔转头看向徐士凯。“喂，你在这里也没什么用，帮我送她回去吧！”
“我？”徐士凯不可置信的指着自己。这大熊怎么转性了？上次他多跟他女朋友讲两句话还被他瞪半天，现在他居然放心把女朋友交给他？
乔若曦感觉像是被人从头浇了一盆冷水，身体冷了，心也冻结住了。
她现在才知道他为什么让她进来，他想撮合她跟另一个男人吗？因为他知道了她原本想告白的对象是他？
他就这么大方？还是说……他根本完全不在意她，所以可以轻易把她推给另一个人？
她捂住唇，却掩不住逸出口的呜咽，她伤心欲绝的看他一眼，然后低头转身离开。
“咦？怎么了？等等——”搞不清发生什么事的徐士凯匆匆的追着她出去。

病房里的褚天阔紧咬牙关，阻止自己开口唤回她。
她最后那惊愕、凄楚、控诉的目光刺痛了他的心，好像他做了什么不可原谅的事一样。她喜欢的不是士凯吗？他给他们机会独处，她不是应该很高兴吗？
可是她那么伤心，眼泪一下子就涌进眼眶，可怜的样子让他好心疼……
急切的目光锁在窗外，没多久就看到她脚步虚浮的身影走出医院大门。她低着头像在擦眼泪，而徐士凯在她身旁，用手搂着她的肩……
看见这一幕，他没受伤的手几乎要把病床的栏杆给捏断。
阿丰随着老大的视线望出去，终于知道老大为什么会知道大嫂在医院门口了，也把他的反应看在眼里。
“唉，老大，你这是何苦呢？大嫂这么好的女人你偏偏要往外推，人被你赶走以后你又放不下。”阿丰实在忍不住了，这几天看老大这样他都憋得快疯了。
“她喜欢的人是他。”
“啥？不会吧？怎么可能！”
褚天阔脸色难看。“其实她要告白的对象不是我，从头到尾是个错误。”
content_en:
"Okay! I'll help you with this." With a tone of charity, Hong Xiaoqi snatched the thermos bottle from Qiao Ruoxi's hand, and Hong Xiaoqi secretly rejoiced.
"Thank you." Qiao Ruoxi, who was relieved, thanked her repeatedly.
Qiao Ruoxi came in the morning the next day, waiting in front of the hospital gate with a pot of beef stew soup. When she saw Hong Xiaoqi, she rushed forward to greet her, happy to wait for her. Otherwise, I don’t know how to serve this pot of soup!
"Hello, Miss Hong."
"Why are you still here?"
"Uh..." Faced with her impatient attitude, Qiao Ruoxi was embarrassed and didn't know how to answer. "Um...did he drink yesterday's chicken soup?"
"Yes!" Hong Xiaoqi smiled proudly. "Brother Tiankuo also praised me and said he didn't know I was so considerate! I think he will no longer treat me as a little girl in the future, but will start to notice my good qualities and maybe fall in love with me!"
She originally said this to make Qiao Ruoxi angry and make her complain that she was being robbed of credit for her hard work, but Qiao Ruoxi's reaction was much different from what she expected -
She said as if she was relieved: "Really? He drank it, that would be great."
Is this woman a fool? Hong Xiaoqi frowned.
"Can I trouble you to give him this pot of soup again today?"
Qiao Ruoxi offered the soup in her hand respectfully, looking up to her beggingly as if she was afraid she would disagree.
Since someone volunteered to be a gunman, she would not take advantage of someone being sent to her door.
"Okay!"
Looking at Hong Xiaoqi's back as he turned around and walked into the hospital, Qiao Ruoxi's eyes were full of envy.
How she wished she was the one who could walk into Tiankuo's ward openly. She really wanted to see him and know if he was okay now.
But at least he will get better soon after drinking the soup...
Qiao Ruoxi felt relieved to be able to provide this little help. She smiled happily and bitterly while thinking about what kind of tonic soup she would make tomorrow...
The days of being trapped in the hospital made Chu Tiankuo extremely depressed.
The injuries on his body didn't bother him. What made him irritated was that Xiao Qi came to see him every day. However, what bothered him was not Xiao Qi, but the soup she brought every day.
How could he not drink? Who did it?
Even if he couldn't drink it, he could still see it. That stupid woman must not know that his single ward has an excellent view. She can see the hospital gate, and of course she can also see the people waiting for Xiao Qi there at about ten o'clock every morning...
"Hey, Big Bear, did you hear me talking to you? What, did you break your brain?"
A voice called his eyes back from the window.
He looked at Xu Shikai with a sullen face, and at his friend's handsome and enviable face.
As friends, I wouldn't have paid much attention to him before, but now that I think about it carefully, I can see that he has the qualities to attract women's attention - he comes from a well-established family, has a high degree of education, is good-looking, has a strong body but not too strong, and the most important thing is that he speaks humorously and knows how to please girls.
I had to admit that he was much better than me, so it was no wonder that Ruo Xi liked him.
She should have discovered it from the beginning. How could she think that she would still fall in love with Xu Shangkai when he was around?
"Why don't you speak? Why are you looking at me like this? It's scary! Big Bear, are you really confused?" Xu Shikai was stared at in confusion. His friend's eyes were dark and sharp, making him tremble with fear, as if he had done something sorry for him.
"Nothing, thank you for your concern."
He finally looked away, and the pressure that was as heavy as a boulder on his shoulders suddenly disappeared, and Xu Shikai breathed a sigh of relief. "By the way, why didn't you see your girlfriend? Didn't she come to take care of you?"
Hearing this, Chu Tiankuo pursed his lips.
Here it comes again, Xu Shikai complained secretly.
What happened to him today? Why does it seem like nothing you say is right? Xu Shikai swallowed. Daxiong is usually very taciturn, but he has never used the underworld brotherThat side has treated him before, but today he really experienced his innate and amazing sense of oppression.
"What do you think of her?"
"Who? Oh, you mean your girlfriend? That's great! Well... she's not the kind of beauty that makes people stunning at first sight, but she should feel very comfortable with her. She's virtuous and gentle. She's the type that makes people want to marry her."
He thought praising his girlfriend would make him feel better, but it obviously didn't, because Chu Tiankuo's expression was even more terrifying just now.
"A Feng!" Chu Tiankuo raised his voice and called A Feng over.
"Boss, what's the matter?" "Let her in."
The boss suddenly said this out of nowhere, and Afeng was confused for a moment, until Chu Tiankuo said impatiently: "That person standing at the door of the hospital now, go down and call her up!"
"Oh, okay!" Without daring to ask any more questions, Afeng hurriedly went out to do the things assigned by the boss.
When he arrived at the door of the hospital, Afeng opened his eyes wide. He knew who the boss was talking about. But the most powerful one is the boss. He has never left the ward. How does he know that the sister-in-law is here?
"Sister-in-law, please go up and see him, boss."
Qiao Ruoxi, who was originally waiting for Hong Xiaoqi, was surprised and happy. "He asked me to see him? Really?"
"Yes, come up quickly! The boss said it himself."
"Okay, okay."
As she happily followed Afeng into the elevator, Qiao Ruoxi's originally pale face turned red with excitement. He was finally willing to see her. When she saw him later, she would first see how his injuries were, and ask him if he was still uncomfortable and what he wanted to eat. Also, she had to take this opportunity to resolve the misunderstanding with him...
"Boss, people are here."
Afeng knocked on the door of the ward. The smile on Qiao Ruoxi's face stiffened slightly when she saw another person in the ward, and then she became anxious to care about Chu Tiankuo's injury.
Huran nodded to Xu Shangkai, and quickly approached Chu Tiankuo. "Are you okay? How are you doing now?"
"Thank you for your concern." His voice was cold and distant, as polite as a stranger.
She suppressed her hurt feelings and encouraged herself that he was willing to see her, saying that everything was about to turn around.
"I brought you some food. You'll get better faster if you eat nutritious food."
"No need to bother." Still refusing indifferently, Chu Tiankuo turned to look at Xu Shikai. "Hey, you're of no use here, help me send her back!"
"Me?" Xu Shikai pointed at himself in disbelief. How did this big bear change his gender? Last time he said a few words to his girlfriend and she got glared at him for a long time, but now he can trust his girlfriend to him?
Qiao Ruoxi felt as if someone had poured cold water on her head. Her body was cold and her heart was frozen.
Only now did she know why he let her in. Did he want to set her up with another man? Because he knew that the person she originally wanted to confess to was him?
Is he so generous? Or... he doesn't care about her at all, so he can easily push her to another person?
She covered her lips, but she couldn't hide the sobs coming out of her mouth. She looked at him sadly, then lowered her head and turned to leave.
"Eh? What's wrong? Wait -" Xu Shikai, who couldn't figure out what happened, hurriedly chased her out.
Chu Tiankuo in the ward gritted his teeth to stop himself from calling her back.
Her last look of shock, sorrow, and accusation pierced his heart, as if he had done something unforgivable. Doesn't she like Shikai? Shouldn't she be happy that he gave them a chance to be alone?
But she was so sad, tears welled up in her eyes all of a sudden, and her pitiful look made him feel so sad...
His eager eyes were locked outside the window, and soon he saw her figure walking out of the hospital door with sloppy steps. She lowered her head as if wiping tears, and Xu Shikai was beside her, putting his arm around her shoulders...
Seeing this scene, his uninjured hand almost broke the railing of the hospital bed.
AfonAs the boss looked out, he finally understood why he knew that his sister-in-law was at the entrance of the hospital and saw his reaction.
"Hey, boss, why are you bothering? You have to push away such a good woman like my sister-in-law, and you can't let go of someone after you drive her away." Afeng couldn't bear it anymore. Seeing the boss like this these days made him almost crazy.
"The person she likes is him."
"What? No way? How is it possible!"
Chu Tiankuo's face looked ugly. "Actually, the person she wanted to confess to was not me. It was a mistake from beginning to end."
